Test Case Description: Verify inline validation when omitting mandatory registration fields
PreRequisites:
- User is not logged in
- Registration page is displayed
Test Case Expected Result: Inline validation errors are shown for each missing required field. Registration is blocked until all mandatory fields are filled.

Step Expected Result:
- Error messages displayed for each missing field:
  - 'Vui lòng nhập tên đăng nhập'
  - 'Vui lòng nhập email'
  - 'Vui lòng nhập mật khẩu'
- All empty required fields are highlighted in red
- Đăng ký button is disabled or form is not submitted
- No API request is sent
